hazards.source_text: These extraordinary rainfalls in inland areas, in the headwaters of rivers and ravines that have their birth over the 1000 m of altitude, have caused violent floods and ravines that have reached the coastal areas where it has barely rained, causing the most tragic hydrological catastrophe in recent history in Spain, with more than 200 deaths and material losses of millions.
